messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants me to create an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a bicycle. Let me think about what elements I need:

1. A bicycle - two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals
2. A pelican - body, wings, the distinctive large beak with pouch, legs/feet on pedals

Let me design this as a side-view illustration. I'll use simple shapes and paths to create a charming, cartoon-like pelican on a bicycle.

Let me think about the composition:
- The bicycle will be at the bottom - two circles for wheels, a frame connecting them, handlebars, a seat, and pedals
- The pelican will be sitting on the seat, facing to the right, with its distinctive large beak, wings gripping the handlebars, and feet on the pedals

Let me build this step by step with coordinates. I'll make it roughly 500x400 or so.

Bicycle:
- Rear wheel: circle at ~(150, 300), r=50
- Front wheel: circle at ~(380, 300), r=50
- Frame lines connecting wheels to seat area
- Handlebars near front wheel
- Seat post going up

Pelican:
- Body sitting on the seat
- Long neck and head facing forward/right
- Large beak with pouch
- Wings reaching to handlebars
- Feet on pedals

Let me create this with clean paths and shapes.
answer:
```svg

  <line x1="142" y1="418" x2="218" y2="342" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <circle cx="420" cy="380" r="55" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>

  <line x1="382" y1="418" x2="458" y2="342" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Bicycle Frame -->
  <path d="M180,380 L240,280 L380,280 L420,380" fill="none" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M180,380 L280,340 L380,280" fill="none" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M280,340 L280,380" fill="none" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <path d="M380,280 L400,240 L420,240" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <path d="M268,278 Q275,320 282,350 Q285,365 288,372 L290,380" fill="none" stroke="#f4a460" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M290,380 L298,378 M290,380 L298,382 M290,380 L298,380" fill="none" stroke="#f4a460" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Tail feathers -->
  <path d="M215,235 Q195,225 185,215 Q180,210 178,205" fill="none" stroke="#d4a84b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M218,240 Q200,235 190,228 Q185,224 183,218" fill="none" stroke="#d4a84b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M220,245 Q205,242 195,238 Q190,235 188,230" fill="none" stroke="#e8d5a8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <line x1="100" y1="370" x2="130" y2="370" stroke="#8b9dc3" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="90" y1="385" x2="125" y2="385" stroke="#8b9dc3" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Small wind lines near head -->
  <line x1="430" y1="135" x2="455" y2="133" stroke="#8b9dc3" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6"/>

</svg>
```

This SVG shows a pelican happily cycling along with:
- 🚲 A red-framed bicycle with spoked wheels, handlebars, seat, and pedals
- 🦤 The pelican's iconic features: a large curved beak with a pouch, a long neck, golden/tan body coloring, and tail feathers
- 🦶 Its webbed feet placed on the pedals
- 🌬️ Motion lines suggesting it's riding with speed
